title: test_user_signup_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /users/logUp successfully registers a new user with valid SUPER_ADMIN or EMPLOYEE data and returns a 201 status with a signup response and token.

title: test_user_login_with_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /users/loginIn authenticates a user with valid credentials and returns a 201 status with a token and user profile.

title: test_search_users_with_valid_jwt_and_keyword
description: Verify that GET /users/search_Word returns a 200 status with an array of matched users when called with a valid JWT and search keyword.

title: test_update_profile_with_valid_jwt_and_payload
description: Verify that PATCH /users/updateMyProfile updates the current logged-in user's profile and returns a 200 status with updated user details when provided with a valid JWT and valid update payload.

title: test_delete_profile_with_valid_jwt
description: Verify that DELETE /users/deleteMyProfile deletes the current logged-in user's profile and returns a 200 status with deletion confirmation when called with a valid JWT.

title: test_attendance_check_in_with_valid_jwt
description: Verify that POST /attendance/check-in records an employee's check-in, calculates delay or on-time status, and returns a 201 status with the attendance record when called with a valid employee JWT.

title: test_attendance_check_out_after_check_in
description: Verify that POST /attendance/check-out records an employee's check-out, calculates early leave and worked time, and returns a 201 status with the updated attendance record when called after a valid check-in.

title: test_manager_dashboard_with_valid_jwt_and_date
description: Verify that GET /managing/dashboard returns a 200 status with dashboard statistics for the specified date when called with a valid manager JWT and date parameter.

title: test_employee_profile_retrieval_with_valid_jwt
description: Verify that GET /employee/profile returns a 200 status with the user profile and EmployeeProfile including department and shift details when called with a valid employee JWT.

title: test_employee_today_status_with_valid_jwt
description: Verify that GET /employee/today-status returns a 200 status with today's attendance status and shift information when called with a valid employee JWT.
